'''Bayonard Peace and Security''', or the '''BPS''', was the security force for the town of [[Bayonard]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and it operated during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Its relation to the [[Office of Peace and Security]] is uncertain.
